_comment: signal_modulation/05_spread_passive (2026-09-09): PASSIVE DIFFRACTION DIAGNOSTIC — how far does ONE strip spread crossing the 20 um crystal? Upper strip (source_4, y=+10.3125) only, NO pump, gain DISABLED (sted.enabled=false -> plain n=1.82 dielectric), no populations. Answers whether neighbouring strips can overlap INSIDE the gain region (z_R ~ 20 um for a 4 um strip): if the beam barely widens by the crystal exit, in-gain cross-mixing is impossible at this length and the I(y)-shape invariance under matched drive is explained. Y SIZE 10 (user, 2026-09-09): single centred strip in a 10-um slab, cell_y 14. field_map = full-cell 2Ddft at 1.064 over the settled half of a short run. Linear physics -> amplitude irrelevant.

crystal._comment: Nd:YAG gain, design-05 model: emission (stimulated 3->2) + pump only, NO rate_32. Scaled doping SGMA 1.86e-5 over 20 um -> same gL (3.72e-4*N3) as design04's literal doping over 600 um, so single-pass gain matches. Widened to 27.5 um so the four 4-um strips fit (design04's transverse layout).

snap_point._comment: output y-LINE time record (1Dsnap = line in y). The multi-strip output is y-dependent, so a single point misses the transverse profile; this records the whole output-guide y-line vs time. dt 20 (coarse on purpose) keeps storage modest for long/many runs — tune down toward the 1.064 carrier period (~1.06 t.u.) if you need the field phase rather than the envelope.

source_4._comment: single 2-um strip, centred, passive spread test in the 10-um slab

field_map._comment: full-cell |E|(x,y) at 1.064 over 300-600. Includes the source point — clip the colour scale when plotting (known full-domain-2Ddft gotcha).
